The Best Portable Milagrow CoinSucker- Pro Vacuum Cleaner To Effortlessly Clean Dust, Cigarette Ash, Pet Hair, Food Spills And Debris Etc. From Your Car And Home. It Can Continuously Run Up To 28 Minutes Ensuring You Can Clean The Entire Car Interior And Home Space With Hassles . The Vacuum Cleaner Includes 3 Versatile Attachments, A Flexible Hose Pipe, A Nozzle, And A Brush Allowing For Thorough Cleaning Of Car Interiors, Car Floors, Home Furniture, Book Shelves, Kitchen & Wardrobe Corners, Small Food Spillage Etc. In Hard-to-reach Areas And Normal Cleaning Routine. Weighing Just 700 Grams, With A 500 Ml Dust Bin, It’s Compact And Easy To Use With One Hand. Equipped With A Reusable HEPA-13 Filter It Traps Fine Dust Efficiently.

About this product

    1. Powerful Suction- A 120W Motor And Durable Aluminum Fan Blades Delivers 10,000 Pa Powerful Suction To Quickly And Efficiently Pick Up Dust, Pet Hair, Cigarette Ash And Debris, Keeping Your Car And Home Interiors Spic & Span.
    2. Complete Cleaning Kit- The Vacuum Cleaner Is Equipped With A 6000mAh Battery That Offers 23 To 28 Minutes Of Continuous Runtime, Providing Ample Cleaning Time. It Includes 3 Versatile Attachments— A Hose Pipe, A Nozzle, And Nozzle Brush, Ensuring Effective Cleaning Of Every Surface.
    3. Compact And Ergonomic Design- Weighing Just 700 Grams, This Lightweight Yet Powerful And Sleek Vacuum Is Easy To Operate With One Hand. Its 500 Ml Dust Bin Allows For More Debris Collection, Making Cleaning Quicker And Efficient.
    4. Efficient HEPA-13 Filter- The Vacuum Cleaner Features An Advanced HEPA-13 Filter That Enhances Fine Dust Filtration, Suction Power And Motor Efficiency. It Can Be Cleaned, Washed, Dried And Reused, Maintaining Strong Suction And Extending The Vacuum’s Lifespan For Long Years.
    5. Buy With Confidence- If You Have Any Questions Or Concerns, Our Customer Service Team Is Here To Help. We Are Dedicated To Providing The Best Solution To Meet Your Needs.
